positive_snippets: Nearby business park and ICICI HDFC Bank office. The rooms are clean but you may notice some unharmful flying insectsat night when lights are off. Complimentary in room breakfast is offered. Day resturant is not available but it is literally next to Domions and few other bearby resturants. Oral hygine kit was provided on demand. Overall staff was helpful.

Everything’s nice about this small, boutique business hotel!

My 3rd visit here & i would keep coming back.

Prasenjit is extremely helpful as always.
Rupam helped to close the booking quite swiftly.

Location is right next to Candor Techspace.
Food is something they can improve on - the stuffed paranthas have very less potato filling.
Wi-fi is not the smoothest, but sufficient - they probably need more routers & a higher bandwidth.

People who’re complaining about ACs not working during the day probably don’t understand how centralised Aircon works.. hotel have given both overhead hitachi ACs and big centralised vents to control the airflow as per your needs. During the day you need to use the Centralised Aircon instead of overhead ones which in my opinion is sufficient.

Tip: while check-in, go for rooms with glass windows (all the ones towards the exterior side of the building).

Pretty old property, rooms are not maintained well and you get some smell
Reception is too good and nothing is renovated for past decade
negative_snippets:
I had a very disappointing experience at this hotel. While booking, I clearly mentioned multiple times that I needed a room with windows due to health reasons. Despite that, I was given a room with no windows at all.

The room was extremely dusty and poorly maintained. The cleanliness standards were unacceptable — there was visible dust everywhere, and the ventilation was terrible. Because of this environment, my allergy got triggered and I even started developing throat irritation/infection during my stay.

When you're staying for work, basic hygiene and proper ventilation are not luxuries — they are necessities. Unfortunately, the hotel did not take my request seriously even after repeated communication.
I would strongly recommend to refrain from booking such hotels to future guests to , especially if you have allergies or health concerns.

Very disappointed with the management and overall maintenance.
